messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 10:05 UTC - Quality regression detected for tenant corp-omega in dedicated pool dpool-17. metric=response_quality_score -18% over 5m. suspect=quant_profile v3.2 deployed at 09:58 UTC. alert_id=a1b2c3
maya (oncall-sre): paging — I\'m on it. assigning triage.
raj (eng-runtime): noted. I\'ll pull runtime logs and kernel warnings for dpool-17.
lena (ml-infra): quant v3.2 rollout id=r-778 pushed to dpool-17,dpool-18 at 09:58 via canary job. previous stable = v3.1.
tom (customer-success): corp-omega reported higher hallucination/paraphrase errors in their assistant ~10:15 UTC, escalated to P1. Customer impact: production traffic, some queries returning nonsensical facts.
maya (oncall-sre): scope check — is this tenant-only? or all tenants on dpool-17?
lena (ml-infra): quick metrics: only corp-omega shows quality drop and token-repetition spike. other tenants in dpool-17 ok. isolating to tenant config + quant path.
raj (eng-runtime): grabbing agent logs. I see repeated int8 dequant warnings on GPU0 during first post-deploy requests. snippet:```WARN runtime/kernel: dequant mismatch on block 12 - fallback to slower path```
raj (eng-runtime): also seeing increased response latency for corp-omega sessions right after their first few requests — likely hitting a slower fallback kernel path after quant change.
maya (oncall-sre): customer-impact summary: single tenant (corp-omega) in dedicated pool dpool-17 experiencing quality regressions and increased latency. SEV=P1 for support.
sofia (account-ops): I\'ll open a customer advisory: "We are investigating a model configuration regression affecting your dedicated pool. We are performing a targeted rollback and will update in ~10m."
lena (ml-infra): proposed mitigation (targeted):
1) Revert quant_profile for corp-omega to v3.1 only (tenant-scoped)
2) Pin model variant to previous working variant (model-x.y) for that tenant
3) Monitor QA/quality metrics for next 15m, then gradually re-introduce if stable
commands to run (runtime CLI):
```bash
redwoodctl tenant update-config --tenant corp-omega --pool dpool-17 --quant-profile v3.1 --pin-model model-x.y
```
maya (oncall-sre): plan sounds good. execute now. I\'ll run the CLI and watch.
incident-bot: [ACTION] started - run_id=run-993; triggered by maya at 10:09 UTC.
maya (oncall-sre): running: `redwoodctl tenant update-config --tenant corp-omega --pool dpool-17 --quant-profile v3.1`
maya (oncall-sre): CLI returned 200 - config applied for tenant corp-omega. change propagated to pool nodes.
raj (eng-runtime): watching metrics and logs. initial signs: per-request fallback warnings stop after config change. latency returning to baseline for corp-omega sessions.
lena (ml-infra): quality metrics: response_quality_score recovering — up 12% within first 4 minutes post-revert.
tom (customer-success): notifying corp-omega: "We rolled back a recent internal config change for your tenant and are monitoring. Expect improvements now. Will update in 15 minutes"
maya (oncall-sre): continuing to monitor for 15m. if stable, will close alert. documenting steps for postmortem: root cause hypothesis = quant v3.2 introduced an int8 kernel path that performs poorly on corp-omega\'s model/sequence distribution causing quality regressions.
raj (eng-runtime): follow-up actions: add additional pre-rollout smoke test for tenant-specific sequence distributions; add kernel fallback telemetry to catch similar mismatches earlier.
lena (ml-infra): will rollback rollout-id r-778 for dpool-17 canary and mark v3.2 as `do-not-promote` until further investigation.
sofia (account-ops): logging this incident for the account file and scheduling a post-incident call with corp-omega for tomorrow.
maya (oncall-sre): handoff: I\'m passing to raj for extended monitoring and post-incident writeup. oncall transfer at 10:20 UTC.
raj (eng-runtime): acknowledged. I\'ll own monitoring and coordinate the postmortem with ml-infra.
incident-bot: [RESOLVE CHECK] alert a1b2c3 - quality metrics recovering; awaiting 15m stable window before auto-close.
sofia (account-ops): thanks team, updating customer thread now.
maya (oncall-sre): closing loop here; will add timeline + commands to incident doc. if anything changes ping me. :thumbsup:
